description: Unit test class for the MongoQueryBuilder, specifically testing unlimited instances and various query configurations such as criteria, sorting, limit, and skip.

classes.name: MongoQueryBuilderUnlimitedTest
classes.description: JUnit test for the MongoQueryBuilder class focusing on unlimited query instances and validation logic.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mock Criteria and creates a MongoQueryBuilder instance with unlimited criteria before each test.

methods.name: createWithNullCriteria
methods.description: Tests that passing null to MongoQueryBuilder.unlimited throws a NullPointerException.

methods.name: buildWithCriteriaOnly
methods.description: Verifies that the built query contains only the criteria set.

methods.name: buildWithSort
methods.description: Tests adding sort options to the query.

methods.name: buildWithSkip
methods.description: Tests setting a skip value in the query.

methods.name: buildWithVeryHighLimit
methods.description: Verifies that setting a very high limit (Integer.MAX_VALUE) is handled correctly.

methods.name: buildWithLimitLessThanZero
methods.description: Ensures that setting a negative limit throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: buildWithSkipLessThanZero
methods.description: Ensures that setting a negative skip throws IllegalArgumentException.
